node.title: L1 coarse p-free Wronskian neighbor compiler
node.statement: Fix an anchor A in a coarse p-free depth-d fiber and a t-subset X of A exchanged by a neighbor B. The collision Wronskian W=F_X'F_Y-F_XF_Y' is nonzero, has degree at most D_t=2t-d-2, and is nonzero on X union Y. For fixed X, W determines the monic opposing tail F_Y uniquely. The exact number of degree-at-most-D certificates nonzero on X is R_q(t,D)=sum_j (-1)^j binom(t,j)q^max(D+1-j,0), giving the arbitrary-target neighbor bound 1+sum_(t>=tau_p) binom(a,t)min(binom(n-a,t),R_q(t,2t-d-2)), where tau_p=max(ceil((d+2)/2),min(d+1,p)). At formal half-depth excess j, certificate degree is 2j for even d and 2j+1 for odd d, but tame-tail strata below tau_p are empty. The exchanged-subset choice can remain exponential, so this compiler does not prove row-sharp Q, Pade coalescing, or L1.
